schema_fields.acceptance: Stable assertion objects. id is immutable and text is the human-verifiable claim.
schema_fields.assertion_ids: The exact acceptance ids that one runnable contract or phase is allowed to claim.
schema_fields.artifact_prefix: Required filename prefix for fresh artifacts created by that contract or phase.
schema_fields.required_artifacts: Named evidence roles. Every entry has a stable role and a semantic kind; minimum counts alone never satisfy these roles.
schema_fields.supports_assertion_ids: Every required artifact names the non-empty subset of its phase assertion_ids that the artifact can directly support; artifacts never receive assertion credit outside that subset.
schema_fields.distinct: Every required artifact role declares distinct=true. One path or one byte-identical capture cannot satisfy two distinct required evidence items or cases.
schema_fields.min_items: A screenshot_set declares its exact required cardinality; the global screenshot minimum is the sum of screenshot roles and screenshot_set min_items.
schema_fields.case_ids: Every screenshot_set binds each required capture to one stable case_id; unlabelled extra screenshots do not close a missing case.
schema_fields.required_parent_collections: Named collection.json lineage that must already have passed before this contract may start.
schema_fields.parent_compatibility_requirements: Mandatory for every parent edge: collection schema 4, the same matrix and current candidate, the same pinned game files and canonical roots, and ready_for_lead_review=true.
schema_fields.required_input_saves: Named immutable input-save roles, including their producing parent artifact or external provenance role; an external original also pins filename, size, SHA-256, and semantic content identity.
schema_fields.required_fixture_uses: Non-release run-file use contract. Each use binds the exact file to a console screenshot and distinct before/after saves.
schema_fields.typed_cases: Scenario-specific case arrays use stable case_id and type fields, bind assertion_ids and evidence roles, and never infer an omitted expected oracle.
schema_fields.closure_contract: A non-runnable release closure declares its six assertion ids, all seventeen compatible parent collections, and every required closure artifact in one auditable contract.
schema_fields.blockers: Structured conditions with id, type, status, blocked assertion ids, ready-state effect, and an explicit resolution requirement; blockers are never waived or converted into a pass.
